cards.label: Diving Spin

cards.label: Big Buster
cards.name: Rude Buster

cards.label: Chain Buster
cards.name: Rude Buster

cards.label: Armor Buster
cards.name: Rude Buster
cards.how: data side only: Super Armor break 9 and 'ignore block' on every Rude Buster bolt, guard.ignore for the command; the guard cut (dr_pt_guard) has no owner yet, so 'guarding enemies take full damage' has nothing to undo

cards.label: Push Buster
cards.name: Rude Buster

cards.label: Timed Buster

cards.label: Red Buster
cards.name: Red Buster

pairs.text: The chain goes on to every enemy on screen, up to 8 hops.
The chain carries fire to each enemy it reaches.
The timed press also works on Fireshock's second burst.
The crescent ignites when it passes through a burning enemy.
Fireshock erupts along Red Buster's whole path.
The dash cuts in a wider range.
Enemies knocked aside shorten the recharge.
The dive bounces back up from the first enemy it hits.
Each loop of the combo shortens the recharge further.
Every enemy the chain reaches is Marked.
Bouncing off an enemy also restores a jump.

kris_burn.standin: the stock Burn aura (not wired even when the pack has it: KINDLE own_fx is off)
kris_burn.where: a gated hit effect on every action that burns, once KINDLE own_fx is on

kris_charge.where: on Kris for the whole of kris_charge (0.7 s to full, then held)

kris_fs_burst_big.where: the hit effect of fs_burst_b (on each enemy it hits)

kris_fs_burst_c.where: the hit effect of fs_burst_c (on each enemy it hits)

kris_fs_chain.where: the flight body of fs_chain (AddEffects, the whole flight)

kris_fs_field.where: AddEffects on fs_field from 0 s, on the floor

kris_fs_pillar.where: AddEffects on fs_pillar from 0 s, on the floor at its spot

kris_fs_spread.where: AddEffects on fs_spread / fs_spread_n (the script launches them)

kris_heal.where: on Kris when Heal Prayer or Second Wind heals (a buff's effect, 1 s)

kris_mark.where: on a Marked enemy for the mark's 5 s: a buff's effect, at the top of its body

kris_rb_chain_link.standin: nothing (no link is drawn where a hop leaves)

kris_rb_detonate.where: AddEffects on rb_detonate from 0 s, at its centre

kris_rb_push.standin: nothing (no push effect of its own)

kris_trio.where: on Susie and Ralsei (and Kris) while both are ready: a buff's effect, as long as the buff

talent.name: Second Wind
talent.desc: Once per room, when HP falls to 30% or less, restores HP and Susie and Ralsei are ready at once.
